plan.purpose: supplement original Column seeds 1-9 with approved seed 10

point_reuse_audit.note: Mixed-date fixed-path cost estimates; not online runtime or a fallback/retry sequence.

affinity.policy: one logical CPU; not an exclusive reservation

selection_manifest.cost_policy: Each callback uses one selected point measurement. For successful CSTR30 retries, use only the retry result and time; exclude the initial failed attempt cost. Repeated calls reuse the same measurement.

successful_retry_audit.policy: Use only the successful retry result and its measured evaluation time; exclude the initial failed attempt cost.

followup_selection.column: Original seeds 1-9 plus seed 10 for all four methods
followup_selection.small_batch: Replace all four methods with full-domain {1,2,3}^3 runs, seeds 0-9, budget 10
followup_selection.small_batch_rbfopt: MSRSM + solver + rbf=auto; October 13 Dantzig supplement replaces the ten sampling runs
followup_selection.dfo_clock: result_record.wall_time_s for every method, matching the original figures
followup_selection.point_costs: Every callback charged its measured point cost, including repeated and rejected evaluations

selection_manifest.missing_time_policy: No aggregate time or time-profile curve for a group with missing measurements; all outcomes retained
